description.value: Takysie Lake Resort is a remote, family-run lakeside retreat roughly 70 km south of Burns Lake, offering rustic cabins and RV/tent sites on a lake celebrated for its wild BC rainbow trout fishing. Under new ownership since 2024, the multigenerational family crew operates an on-site café, general store, hardware store, pay-at-pump gas station, and mechanic shop, making it a rare self-contained stop in an otherwise sparse stretch of BC interior. For touring cyclists, it provides fuelling, food, and overnight shelter in a genuinely secluded and scenic backcountry setting.

address.value: 37530 Eakin Settlement Road, Burns Lake, V0J 1E4
